messages.text:
Found it. The relay itself is working; the voice hook needed to be more tolerant of the current ChatGPT UI.
I made QSV 2.4 as a new complete source. It now:
hovers the newest GPT response first, to reveal response controls
looks for Read Aloud inside that response
falls back to searching visible global buttons, because the control may be rendered outside the response container
retries briefly while the toolbar settles
logs each attempt
still treats failure to start Read Aloud as non-fatal to the relay
And the source passes Python syntax checking.
Download qsv_2.4.py
Save it as qsv.py and run that one for the next shop test.
The key thing I like here: we're not messing with the part that already proved it can send → get response → stabilize → extract response. We're narrowing the fix to the one broken bit: “okay, now make her talk.” 🎙️🦆
